name: Jausenstation Goingstätt
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Goingstätt Jausenstation in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser!**

Discover our cozy mountain hut nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Here, you’ll find hearty **Tiroler** specialties to fuel your adventures in the **Kaisergebirge**.

Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and served with fresh fruit or a dollop of **Apfelmus**. For a savory bite, indulge in **Käsespätzle**, crispy **Leberknödelsuppe**, or a juicy **Schweinsbraten** with **Semmelknödeln**.

Enjoy our homemade **Kuchen** and **Torten**, paired with a steaming cup of **Kaffee** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**. Whether you're hiking the **Wilden Kaiser** trails or taking a break after a day of skiing, our warm hospitality and delicious food will make your visit unforgettable.

**Come by and taste the true flavors of the Alps!**
